lines: His father had threatened to stone him. His people had tried to burn him. A king had argued against his Lord.
And one man believed in him: Lut, alayhis salaam.
So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, left his people, and Allah brought him and Lut to a land He had blessed.
He said: "Indeed, I will go to my Lord. He will guide me."
He said: I will leave you and what you worship besides Allah, and I will call upon my Lord.
And as he grew older, he made one more dua: "My Lord, grant me a child from among the righteous."
And Allah gave him good news: a forbearing boy.
